question: The value of frac{{tan 85^circ - tan25^circ }}{{1 + tan85^circ tan25^circ }} is:
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: (tan 85° - tan 25°) / (1 + tan 85° × tan 25°)

**Formula used:**

tan(A - B) = (tan A - tan B) / (1 + tan A × tan B)

Where A = 85° and B = 25°.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The expression can be rewritten using the formula:

⇒ (tan 85° - tan 25°) / (1 + tan 85° × tan 25°) = tan(85° - 25°)

⇒ = tan(60°)

⇒ tan(60°) = √3

**∴ The value of (tan 85° - tan 25°) / (1 + tan 85° × tan 25°) is √3.**
